policy.missing_tool_strategy: degrade to pure HTML/SVG, existing Python/Pillow/ReportLab, Poppler/Ghostscript, or FFmpeg; never block final integration on tool installation
policy.model_bridge_policy: consume upstream GLB/PNG/sections/bridge package when materialized; missing Blender/native 3D does not block F export
policy.browser_print_status: Chromium binary present but current headless print unavailable; WeasyPrint is the tested web-to-PDF fallback.

tools.fallback: WeasyPrint 68.0 for HTML/CSS paged-media PDF; primary F PDFs remain ReportLab; Poppler/Ghostscript verify output.
tools.does_not_prove: The installed Chromium binary is not a valid current PDF-print path in this container. Prior browser PASS elsewhere must not be inferred here.
tools.runtime_status: HEADLESS_PDF_PRINT_SMOKE_FAIL / timeout=20s / DBus+zygote errors / no PDF emitted

tools.actual_smoke: PASS: 20-screen=20 pages at 1440x810 pt; A1=3 pages at 2383.94x1683.78 pt
tools.fallback: ReportLab primary PDF assembly. If WeasyPrint is unavailable, keep ReportLab output and verify with Poppler/Ghostscript.
tools.does_not_prove: WeasyPrint output proves this HTML/CSS renderer path only; it is not Chromium parity and does not prove field/design promotion.

tools.fallback: WeasyPrint paged-media PDF from boards/print_a1_fallback.html or web/print_20screen.html.
tools.does_not_prove: Successful PDF creation does not prove visual quality until rendered/opened and reviewed; it does not prove field/design promotion.

tools.fallback: Ghostscript nullpage/open check; ImageMagick may rasterize simple PDFs but is not the preferred verifier.
tools.does_not_prove: A clean render proves only PDF readability in the tested renderer, not content correctness or design/field validation.
Zero interpreter errors do not prove page aesthetics, source accuracy, or implementation readiness.

tools.command_entry: ffmpeg -i <D_v1.1_motion.mp4> -i <audio_master.m4a> -vf ass=<F.ass>:fontsdir=/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 20 -profile:v high -level:v 4.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 24 -c:a copy -t 86 -movflags +faststart <out.mp4>
tools.fallback: Default fast reproducible delivery uses stream-copy remux of accepted F v0.2; if audio master is absent, only an explicitly named SILENT_FALLBACK may be created for technical QC.
tools.does_not_prove: Successful encode/decode proves container/codec integrity only; it does not prove narration accuracy, copyright clearance, field state, or cinematic design quality.
Probe metadata does not prove successful full-stream decoding or visual quality.

tools.fallback: CairoSVG 2.8.2 via Python; for locked F visuals, prefer existing PNG assets to avoid renderer drift.
tools.does_not_prove: SVG rasterization proves renderer compatibility only, not source-authority or geometry validation.

tools.fallback: ImageMagick command line for resize/convert/composite; preserve source pixels and labels.
tools.does_not_prove: Raster composition does not make provisional spatial/field claims authoritative.
Image conversion does not prove design correctness or source authenticity.

role: SVG-to-PNG/PDF fallback when Inkscape path is unavailable
tools.does_not_prove: Renderer output is presentation evidence only.
Archive creation does not prove contents are valid; hashes and independent open/QC remain required.

fonts.fallback: Noto Sans CJK family -> Liberation Sans/DejaVu Sans; visual regression required if fallback occurs
fonts.does_not_prove: Font availability on this machine does not guarantee identical typography on another host unless PDF/subtitle rasterization is performed here.

fonts.fallback: Liberation Mono or system monospace with regression review
fonts.does_not_prove: Font substitution can change metrics; it must not be assumed layout-equivalent.

missing_non_blocking_tools.fallback: pdfinfo + Poppler render + Ghostscript nullpage; do not install/wait
Inkscape 1.4 or CairoSVG 2.8.2; do not install/wait
consume upstream GLB/PNG/section/model bridge package when supplied; C22 exploded relation remains explicitly non-3D-field-model until then

hard_boundary.global_does_not_prove: EXECUTED / BUILD / RENDER / ENCODE / DECODE PASS never substitutes for Design PASS, Field PASS, compliance, measured geometry, structural adequacy, operational approval, or P2 promotion.

primary_pdf_visual_regression.20screen: 0/20 changed pages at 36 dpi against pre-freeze snapshot after restoring accepted PAGE-11/PAGE-20 overrides

qc_freeze.chromium_pdf_print: NON-BLOCKING FAIL / binary present, headless smoke timeout
